Approved findings

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

HybridFlow: A Flexible and Efficient RLHF Framework (2409.19256v2) · paper method: The single controller passes data futures between roles, while required output data is transferred directly between GPUs according to parallel ranks.

cohort8.claim.hybridflow.data-futures

  • Original author-stage note: Author-only candidate: separate source-verifier and adversarial source-content reviews remain pending.
  • Version-specific primary-source report. Proofs, model experiments, underlying data, consent/pay records and supplier participation have not been independently reproduced or audited.
  • The example is actor generation to critic inference; actual transfer and scheduling behavior depends on the chosen protocols.

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

HybridFlow: A Flexible and Efficient RLHF Framework (2409.19256v2) · paper method: Although ResourcePool supports parallel execution of colocated roles, HybridFlow generally uses sequential execution to avoid contention or out-of-memory failures.

cohort8.claim.hybridflow.general-sequential

  • Original author-stage note: Author-only candidate: separate source-verifier and adversarial source-content reviews remain pending.
  • Version-specific primary-source report. Proofs, model experiments, underlying data, consent/pay records and supplier participation have not been independently reproduced or audited.
  • Fine-grained GPU sharing, offload and heterogeneous-device mapping are explicitly discussed as future research; the pinned arXiv PDF is not publisher-byte verified.

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

HybridFlow: A Flexible and Efficient RLHF Framework (2409.19256v2) · paper method: HybridFlow’s ResourcePool virtualizes GPU sets; models sharing a pool are colocated, while different pool instances map to distinct GPU sets.

  • Original author-stage note: Author-only candidate: separate source-verifier and adversarial source-content reviews remain pending.
  • Version-specific primary-source report. Proofs, model experiments, underlying data, consent/pay records and supplier participation have not been independently reproduced or audited.
  • The paper explicitly assumes no overlap between different ResourcePool instances.

HybridFlow: A Flexible and Efficient RLHF Framework (2409.19256v2) · paper method: HybridFlow attaches collect/distribute transfer protocols to model operations so data can be reshaped between models with different parallelism layouts.
